# Encoded square-SAR color I/P pair

This freezes the controller owner's original procedural
`build/p2-intra-controller/intra-in-p.264`, generated by
`tests/unit/test_p2_intra_controller.sh`. It contains a smooth colored I picture
and a localized textured/color change in the P picture, exercising intra
macroblocks inside P. It is local test artwork, not PMS or external media.

The delivered encoded stream already has 320x240 geometry, explicit square SAR,
two complete I/P access units, and disabled filtering signaled by x264
`no-deblock=1`. The bytes are copied unchanged; no SPS, slice flags, pixels,
coefficients, or references are patched or injected.

```sh
tests/unit/run_gop12_fpga_sim.sh --source-pin worktree --frames 2 --au-publish --au-input-limit 8192 \
  --fixture tests/fixtures/p2_oracle_intra_in_p_filter_off/intra_in_p_320x240_2f.264
```

The ordinary decoder remains unmodified. Passing this pair would not establish
all mode combinations, an entire GOP, sustained throughput, or hardware/glass.
